notes: Works with drives installed without the Ervisio integration: the plugin finds the drive's container in Docker and reaches its API from inside it. A drive found in Docker but stopped can be started from the page. With no drive on the machine, the page installs one: it downloads this release to `/opt/ervisio-drive` and runs `./setup.sh --ervisio yes`, then shows the owner's activation link. manifest.name: ErvisioDrive
manifest.author: Riccardo Reccia
manifest.description: Manage ErvisioDrive on this machine, or install it: storage, members, quotas, settings and statistics, and publish it on its own web address through Caddy. Works with drives installed with or without the Ervisio integration.

commands.description: Read the state of caddy.service and the Caddyfile it loads (to offer a web address for the drive)
commands.name: service-show

commands.description: Check the Caddyfile with caddy validate before Caddy reloads it (in a scratch data folder, so nothing in Caddy's storage changes)
commands.name: validate

commands.description: Reload caddy.service after adding or removing the drive's site
commands.name: reload

commands.description: Check whether Docker is installed (to find the drive or Caddy containers, and before installing the drive)
commands.name: has-docker

commands.description: Read your user name (root uses Docker without an unlock prompt)
commands.name: user

commands.description: Read your groups (members of docker use Docker without an unlock prompt)
commands.name: groups

argv: systemctl stop ervisio-drive-install.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-drive-install.service 2>/dev/null; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-drive-install --description='Install ErvisioDrive' --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh -c "$0" install "$1" "$2" "$3"

set -eu
v="$1"; email="$2"; port="$3"; d=/opt/ervisio-drive
command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo "Docker is not installed"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -f "$d/compose.yaml" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$d"
  url="https://github.com/Ervisio/ErvisioDrive/archive/refs/tags/v$v.tar.gz"
  echo "Downloading $url"
  if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL "$url"; else wget -qO- "$url"; fi | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$d"
fi
cd "$d"
exec ./setup.sh --non-interactive --ervisio yes --admin-email "$email" --port "$port"
commands.description: Install ErvisioDrive in /opt/ervisio-drive when it is not on this machine: download the release matching this plugin from GitHub and run its ./setup.sh --ervisio yes in a systemd unit (ervisio-drive-install), which builds and starts the Docker Compose stack
commands.name: install

commands.description: Read the state of the installation unit (ervisio-drive-install)
commands.name: install-state

commands.description: Read the output of the installation (the journal of ervisio-drive-install)
commands.name: install-log
